name: scos-memory-fabric
description: Connects Claude Code to the SCOS Memory Fabric via the mcp-gateway service, exposing scos_recall, scos_status, scos_explain, scos_user_model, scos_memory_graph, scos_correct and scos_forget. Includes /scos-recall, /scos-status, /scos-explain commands, a scos-memory skill, and a SessionStart hook.

gateway_url.title: mcp-gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Base MCP endpoint for the SCOS mcp-gateway service (services/mcp-gateway). Defaults to the rabuntu fleet deployment.

bearer_token.title: SCOS bearer token
bearer_token.description: Value of SCOS_HERMES_BEARER_TOKEN from ~/.hermes/scos.env on this machine, or your own issued service token.
